description: Implementation of a service class for reading deposit account interest rate chart data, including methods for retrieving charts, slabs, and templates, with associated nested classes for mapping and extracting data from SQL result sets.

classes.name: DepositAccountInterestRateChartReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing methods to retrieve and process deposit interest rate chart data, including nested classes for mapping and extracting data from SQL result sets.

classes.name: DepositAccountInterestRateChartExtractor
classes.description: ResultSetExtractor for extracting a list of DepositAccountInterestRateChartData from SQL ResultSet.

classes.name: DepositAccountInterestRateChartMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping SQL ResultSet rows to DepositAccountInterestRateChartData objects.

classes.name: InterestRateChartSlabExtractor
classes.description: ResultSetExtractor for extracting DepositAccountInterestRateChartSlabData, including incentives.

classes.name: DepositAccountInterestRateChartSlabsMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping SQL ResultSet rows to DepositAccountInterestRateChartSlabData objects.

classes.name: InterestIncentiveMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping SQL ResultSet rows to DepositAccountInterestIncentiveData objects.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves a deposit interest rate chart by ID.

methods.name: retrieveOneWithSlabs
methods.description: Retrieves a deposit interest rate chart with slabs by ID.

methods.name: retrieveWithTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a deposit interest rate chart with additional template options.

methods.name: retrieveOneWithSlabsOnAccountId
methods.description: Retrieves a deposit interest rate chart with slabs based on account ID.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Creates a template deposit interest rate chart with default options.
